description: Search the authenticated user life graph. Deterministic routing first: food + explicit from/to (aliases start/end) or relative dates (e.g. "what did I eat yesterday?"); timeline/current-context; money+person; who-is → resolve_person. Otherwise semantic/keyword search. Event hits include event_date and food_id when mirrored from Food Diary. Browser-history titles are excluded. Credential/secret spans are redacted. Records carry inspect_url (their Dayze page): cite with it, never build a link from an id; a record without one has no page (inspect_note says which). Requires OAuth or a supported scoped credential. ($0.15; API key required)

from.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD start for structured food search. Pair with to.

to.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD end for structured food search. Pair with from.

name: search

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

inspect_note.description: How to cite: link each record with its inspect_url, never a link built from an id; which record types here have no Dayze page.

inspect_url.description: PHI-434: the Dayze page for this record, when it has one.

photo_url.description: Meal photo on a food result, when one is attached.

title: Semantic Life Search
